title: Wynn Resorts CEO Joins USCBC Board Delegation Visit to China

body_markdown:
*Promoting* *US-* *China Commercial Exchange and Deepening Bilateral Economic Cooperation*


**Macao, Nov 6, 2026** – Members of the US-China Business Council (USCBC) Board of Directors concluded a two-day trip to Beijing on September 2, 2026, aiming to promote bilateral commercial ties and explore new opportunities for US businesses in China. The delegation met with major Chinese officials, including Premier Li Qiang and representatives from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, and Ministry of Commerce, to exchange views on US-China economic and trade relations and the opportunities to deepen bilateral commercial cooperation.


Wynn Resorts CEO Craig Billings also participated in the visit as a member of the USCBC Board of Directors, joining fellow delegates in sharing ideas on US-China economic and trade relations and the development of US businesses in China. Discussions during the meetings focused on the business environment for US companies in China and the broader US-China relationship. The USCBC delegation expressed its commitment to serving as a bridge between the government and the private sector, and helping translate dialogue into meaningful commercial outcomes, strengthening business confidence, and fostering conditions for the continued growth of US-China economic and trade relations.


Established in 1973, USCBC is a private, nonpartisan, nonprofit organization of major American companies that do business in China, representing many of the world's most iconic brands. For more than 50 years, USCBC has advocated on behalf of US businesses while promoting the many benefits of bilateral commercial exchange.
